title: Show a loading/error state when edit-user details fail to load
problem: CHT issue #10155 reports that the admin edit-user modal can render empty fields when user-detail population fails, including an SSO username request failure reproduced with Chrome DevTools offline throttling.
humanitarian_relevance: Reliable user administration matters for health-system deployments, especially where offline users, SSO, and role/facility assignment affect field access. This is operational tooling rather than direct clinical logic.

evidence.claim: Two Chrome DOM probes compile the original edit-user template, modal directive and controller with the real Modal scope service. Pending and failed synthetic SSO lookup both leave an editable blank Add User form, enabled submit action and no error alert. Successful resolution populates and locks the username and changes the title to Edit User. Production styling, Bootstrap window, submission side effects and video remain unverified.

A clean pinned baseline passes all 431 admin tests and three additional browser-based controller probes. Failed SSO/settings requests leave editUserModel unset and only log errors; the successful SSO control populates the model. Those three controller probes alone do not establish rendered-modal/video behavior; subsequent DOM verification is recorded separately. No target patch is claimed.
Issue report describes the failure and points to admin/src/js/controllers/edit-user.js where model population failure is only logged.
A maintainer described the desired flow: show the edit modal with only a spinner while necessary data loads, then render fields after data is loaded.
Prior PR #10824 was closed stale after review requested translation cleanup and a short video showing the spinner; it was not merged.
Read-only source inspection confirmed setupPromise currently catches model-population errors and logs 'Error determining user model' without surfacing a modal error state.
Local branch /private/tmp/humanifest-cht-core@10155-edit-user-load-state maps the source, template, translation, and unit-test surfaces and passes node --check plus git diff --check.
